# Findable

> Findable is an SEO, AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) technical agency helping local businesses, D2C brands, and e-commerce companies achieve dominant rankings on Google, high-authority citations across AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini), and predictable customer acquisition.

Findable specializes in technical search optimization, mobile Core Web Vitals engineering, static architecture, Schema.org semantic graphs, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

For the complete unabridged knowledge base and detailed case study analyses, see [Full Knowledge Base](https://findableseo.vercel.app/llms-full.txt).

## Core Services

- [Search Engine Optimization (SEO)](https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/seo): Technical, on-page, and local SEO services designed to increase search rankings, fix Core Web Vitals, and capture customer demand.
- [Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)](https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/aeo): Optimization for direct answers in Google AI Overviews, featured snippets, and People Also Ask modules.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)](https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/geo): Brand positioning and technical formatting for citations across LLM engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Gemini.
- [SEO-First Website Development](https://findableseo.vercel.app/services/website-development): Static, zero-bloat web development with Astro, delivering sub-second load times and 100/100 Core Web Vitals scores.
- [All Services Hub](https://findableseo.vercel.app/services): Complete portfolio of Findable's organic search, AI discovery, and performance engineering solutions.

## Industry Solutions

- [Local Businesses & GBP](https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/local-businesses): Google Business Profile ranking, local 3-pack dominance, and localized citation management.
- [D2C Brands](https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/d2c-brands): Organic search architecture, automated product schema, and AI brand citation for direct-to-consumer businesses.
- [E-commerce Stores](https://findableseo.vercel.app/industries/ecommerce-brands): Collection, category, and product page optimization designed for high-conversion search traffic.

## Case Studies & Measurable Proof

- [STWELAM Furniture](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/stwelam-furniture-digital-marketing): Scaling monthly revenue to ₹15 Lakh+ via local SEO, #1 Google Maps rankings, and targeted performance marketing.
- [MAXLI Perfumes Brand Growth](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/maxli-perfumes-brand-growth): Scaling a luxury D2C fragrance brand to ₹12 Lakh+ monthly rolling revenue and 150K+ monthly social reach.
- [MaxliOnline E-Commerce Platform](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/maxlionline-ecommerce-platform): Sub-1.2s mobile storefront with 100% rich snippets product schema, 3.8% mobile conversion rate, and -28% checkout abandonment.
- [RASOI Canteen Platform](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/rasoi-smart-canteen-management-system): SaaS platform digitizing school and college canteens, cutting queue wait times by 65% with 99.8% order accuracy.
- [Findable 30-Day Build](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies/findable-30-day-build): Engineering Findable's own website with 100/100 Mobile Lighthouse, 0 KB first-party JS, and 0.8s LCP.
- [All Case Studies](https://findableseo.vercel.app/case-studies): Full library of documented case studies and technical implementations.
